description: Draws a picture from two voltages, one taken as the distance across and one as the distance up

params.text: Scales the drawing about its centre, 0.5 to 4
Sets how many points are held and drawn, 2 to 255; fewer points give a shorter trail

inputs.text: The voltage taken as the distance across; the number of channels here is how many curves are drawn
The voltage taken as the distance up, one channel per curve

notes: points are taken 60 times a second rather than every sample, so a signal at audio rate is drawn from scattered points rather than as a continuous line
with SuperLFO placed immediately to the left, the curve of that module is drawn from its settings and the two jacks are passed over
